layman_headline: Market is cooling off — best to stay patient with current positions and avoid new bets.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is showing signs of fatigue. Fear & Greed has dropped from 69 to 62 in a day, and Bitcoin dominance at nearly 60% means money is flowing away from smaller coins (altcoins) and into Bitcoin. Our two current positions — Solana (up 0.8%) and Uniswap (up 3.1%) — are both green and progressing toward their targets. The swing candidates available right now either lack technical data (no RSI, no MACD signals) or are in steep downtrends without clear bottoming signals, making them risky entries.
layman_action: Hold your current Solana and Uniswap positions. Don't open new trades right now — the setup quality is poor. Watch for UNI approaching its $5.65 target to take profits.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidates present a poor risk/reward profile this cycle. PUMP (-15.4% 7d), PEPE (-14.4% 7d), and APT (-16.1% 7d) are all in significant downtrends but lack critical technical data (RSI, MACD, SMA positioning) to confirm a bottoming pattern — buying these is catching a falling knife. MON has RSI at 63 (slightly overbought) while down 10.6% on the week, a bearish divergence. XAUT is neutral but offers no swing upside. BTC dominance at 59.7% is a headwind for all alts. The Fear & Greed worsening trend (69→62) suggests momentum is fading. Both existing positions (SOL +0.8%, UNI +3.1%) are healthy and within their trade plans. UNI in particular is approaching its $5.65 exit target and deserves close monitoring.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed trending lower (69→62) could accelerate into broader altcoin selloff
BTC dominance at 59.7% continues to compress altcoin valuations

Fear & Greed index: if it drops below 50 into 'Fear' territory, consider tightening stop-losses
SOL holding $98-100 support level — if it breaks below $98, reassess the position
market_context: The market is in a mild risk-off phase with BTC flat and altcoins bleeding. Bitcoin dominance near 60% and deteriorating sentiment (Greed fading) make this a poor environment for new altcoin entries.
context_banner: No high-conviction swing setups available — protect existing gains and wait for clearer technical signals.

Cronos halted its network after a $75M Tectonic exploit, adding negative sentiment to the DeFi sector and increasing caution for altcoin positions.
Most swing candidates lack RSI data entirely; MON's RSI at 63 is mildly overbought, and no candidate shows oversold bounce conditions needed for a high-conviction entry.
No volume breakout signals detected across any swing candidate — all volume_vs_avg readings are null, indicating no unusual buying pressure.
Saylor hinting at BTC purchases is mildly bullish for Bitcoin but reinforces the BTC-dominance narrative that is currently compressing altcoin valuations.
